content: CKModifyRecordsOperation rejects batches over 400 records (CKError.limitExceeded; Hacking with Swift + mackuba.eu WWDC15 notes) and reports per-batch failures as CKError.partialFailure carrying CKPartialErrorsByItemIDKey when isAtomic=false. StressMonitor batches deletes at 300 (CloudKitResetService.deleteBatchRecords) — under the limit; partial failures surface as operation failure and now propagate (v1.0 CR-01 fix 1761b70).
